source.method: Static SWF tag parsing, AVM1 literal and constant-pool instruction decoding, signed-relative branch resolution, and arithmetic substitution only. No SWF, AVM1, ActionScript or game execution.

parameters.boundaryBehavior: Candidate axis is assigned only if strictly within its open range. It is not clamped to either endpoint.

worldBackdrop.relationship: Inside gameworld; inherits gameworld transform. No separate half-speed city root placement at a5.

initialCoordinateAnalysis.method: Arithmetic substitution into decoded load expressions; no runtime execution, ordering simulation or observation.
initialCoordinateAnalysis.caveat: This conditional calculation excludes the known arrival1729 player-position and player-frame overrides. It is not an actual initial playable viewport.
initialCoordinateAnalysis.knownAdditionalWriter: Arrival1729 at depth26 relocates real man1 to local (1190.45,231.4) during its frames1/2/3 and puts it into empty frame265. It restores man1 frame1 at frame122. Thus a raw display-list preview showing man1 at (34.55,317.2) with arrival1729 is not an authentic first playable state. Order relative to world load, enterFrame, character logic, user inputs and saved state is not executed, so no exact first-playable viewport is asserted.

conditionalCameraArithmetic.assumption: If load reads the arrival-assigned player coordinates while the world remains at authored origin and man1 faces right.
conditionalCameraArithmetic.conclusion: Both load candidates are outside their strict valid ranges, so this conditional load alone retains world (0,0). The enterFrame rule eases separately; this does not establish actual order or actual viewport.

renderingGuidance: Full-scene geometry and component previews may use authored transforms. Do not label authored man1 placement or a hypothetical camera crop as actual gameplay state. An arrival-aware illustrative frame must explicitly hide real man1 for arrival frames1-121 and show its restored frame1 at relocated position from arrival frame122, with camera state clearly labeled as illustrative.

declaredArtworkBounds.caveat: Authored geometry extends outside logical camera dimensions. Logical 1300x450 is a camera parameter, not the exact visible-artwork bounding rectangle.
